fit: Pathology-confirmed diagnostic groups and visually guided drawing
assessment: The original criteria give acceptable copies in 2 of 17 Lewy body and 16 of 27 Alzheimer participants (p=0.002). The relaxed criteria give 8 of 17 and 20 of 27 (p=0.11). assessment: The publisher abstract reports retrospective motor outcomes in 64 Parkinson participants, 45 of whom converted to daytime infusion monotherapy. Visual adverse-event detail and possible reuse of the earlier 19-person Colzi cohort remain unverified. This is a medication comparison without fig exposure.

fit: Dried fig material in nonclinical enzyme assays
assessment: The Dottato dried fig material gave the strongest cholinesterase inhibition among the reported cultivars. The original abstract reports acetylcholinesterase and butyrylcholinesterase assay IC50 values of 26.9 and 31.8 micrograms per milliliter. Eating whole fruit, clinical exposure, Parkinson disease and visual episode frequency were outside the assay.
